title: Frontier v1 trial record
description: Captured evidence from one runner execution against one case: the ordered acts taken, the final reported message, and the observable end state. This schema carries no expected outcome, verdict, or grading hint. Grading happens externally, by comparing a trial record against a label.

world_build.description: Digest of the world build that produced this trial.

acts.description: Ordered record of every act the trial took. Order is significant: it is the sequence matched against a label's acceptable_paths. No separate ordering field exists.

orientations.description: Ordered intent activations. These calls are audit evidence and are not executable acts or acceptable-path steps.

final_message.description: The agent's final reported message for the trial. Usable only for deterministic pattern checks, never for outcome judgment by this schema.

args.description: Verb-specific arguments as already-canonical JSON. Arbitrary shape; grading never depends on this field alone.

command.description: Present only when the act corresponds to an external command invocation a grader may check.

output.description: Captured stdout+stderr, or verb output text, for this act.

content.description: Omitted or empty when present is false.
